readings.title: A Warrior's Plea for Deliverance
readings.subtitle: David praises YeHoVaH as his Rock and petitions for rescue from foreign enemies.
readings.text: [Psalm 144:1] Blessed be <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>my</dn> Rock, Who is teaching <dn>my</dn> hands for fighting, <dn>My</dn> fingers for battle; [2] <dn>My</dn> loving-commitment and <dn>my</dn> stronghold, <dn>My</dn> tower and <dn>my</dn> deliverer, <dn>My</dn> shield, and in whom <dn>I</dn> take refuge, Who is subduing peoples under me. [3] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, what is man, that <dn>You</dn> should know him? Son of man, that <dn>You</dn> should think of him? [4] Man is like a breath, <dn>His</dn> days like a passing shadow. [5] Incline <dn>Your</dn> heavens, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and come down; Touch the mountains that they smoke. [6] Send forth lightning and scatter them, Send forth <dn>Your</dn> arrows and confuse them. [7] Send forth <dn>Your</dn> hand from above; Rescue me and deliver me out of great waters, From the hand of foreigners, [8] Whose mouth has spoken falsehood, And whose right hand is a right hand of lies.

readings.title: A New Song and a Blessed People
readings.subtitle: David vows to sing a new song for deliverance, describing the blessings of a nation whose God is YeHoVaH.
readings.text: [Psalm 144:9] O <dn>Elohim</dn>, a new song <dn>I</dn> sing to <dn>You</dn>; On a harp of ten strings <dn>I</dn> sing praises to <dn>You</dn>, [10] Who gives deliverance to sovereigns, Who rescues <dn>את</dn> Daviḏ <dn>His</dn> servant From the evil sword. [11] Rescue me and deliver me from the hand of foreigners, Whose mouth has spoken falsehood, And whose right hand is a right hand of lies; [12] Because our sons are like plants Grown up in their youth; Our daughters like hewn stones, Polished, like a palace building; [13] Let our storehouses be filled, Supplying all kinds; Let our sheep bring forth thousands And ten thousands in our fields; [14] Our cattle well-laden; No breaking in, no going out; And no crying in our streets. [15] Blessed are the people who have it so; Blessed are the people whose <dn>Elohim</dn> is <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>!

readings.title: An Everlasting Praise
readings.subtitle: David exalts YeHoVaH's unsearchable greatness, which is declared from generation to generation.
readings.text: [Psalm 145:1] <dn>I</dn> exalt <dn>You</dn>, <dn>my</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn>, O Sovereign; And bless <dn>Your</dn> Name forever and ever. [2] All day long <dn>I</dn> bless <dn>You</dn>, And praise <dn>Your</dn> Name forever and ever. [3] Great is <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, and greatly to be praised; And <dn>His</dn> greatness is unsearchable. [4] Generation after generation praises <dn>Your</dn> works, And they declare <dn>Your</dn> mighty acts. [5] <dn>I</dn> declare the esteemed splendour of <dn>Your</dn> excellency, And the matters of <dn>Your</dn> wondrous works. [6] And they speak of the might of <dn>Your</dn> awesome acts, And <dn>I</dn> recount <dn>Your</dn> greatness. [7] They send forth the remembrance of <dn>Your</dn> great goodness, And they sing of <dn>Your</dn> righteousness.

readings.title: The Goodness of YeHoVaH's Reign
readings.subtitle: The compassionate and loving nature of YeHoVaH is praised by all His works and His saints.
readings.text: [Psalm 145:8] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> shows favour and is compassionate, Patient and great in loving-commitment. [9] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is good to all, And <dn>He</dn> has compassion on all <dn>His</dn> works. [10] All <dn>Your</dn> works give thanks to <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, And <dn>Your</dn> lovingly-committed ones bless <dn>You</dn>. [11] They speak of the esteem of <dn>Your</dn> reign, And talk of <dn>Your</dn> might, [12] To make known to the sons of men <dn>His</dn> mighty acts, And the esteemed splendour of <dn>His</dn> reign. [13] <dn>Your</dn> reign is an everlasting reign, And <dn>Your</dn> rule is throughout all generations.

readings.title: YeHoVaH's Provision and Preservation
readings.subtitle: He upholds the falling, feeds the hungry, and is near to all who call upon Him in truth.
readings.text: [Psalm 145:14] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is supporting all who are falling, And raising up all who are bowed down. [15] The eyes of all look to <dn>You</dn> expectantly, And <dn>You</dn> are giving them their food in its season, [16] Opening <dn>Your</dn> hand and satisfying The desire of all that live. [17] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is righteous in all <dn>His</dn> ways, And lovingly-committed in all <dn>His</dn> works. [18] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is near to all who call upon <dn>Him</dn>, To all who call upon <dn>Him</dn> in truth. [19] <dn>He</dn> does <dn>את</dn> the desire of those who fear <dn>Him</dn>; And <dn>He</dn> hears <dn>את</dn> their cry and saves them. [20] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> preserves <dn>את</dn> all those loving <dn>Him</dn>, But <dn>את</dn> all the wrong ones <dn>He</dn> destroys. [21] <dn>My</dn> mouth speaks the praise of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, And let all flesh bless <dn>His</dn> set-apart Name, Forever and ever.

readings.title: A Cry from the Depths
readings.subtitle: The psalmist cries out day and night, his soul full of troubles and his life near She'ol.
readings.text: [Psalm 88:1] O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>Elohim</dn> of <dn>my</dn> deliverance, By day <dn>I</dn> have cried out, In the night also before <dn>You</dn>, [2] Let <dn>my</dn> prayer come before <dn>You</dn>, Incline <dn>Your</dn> ear to <dn>my</dn> cry. [3] For <dn>my</dn> being is filled with evils, And <dn>my</dn> life draws near to She’ol. [4] <dn>I</dn> have been reckoned among those Who go down to the pit; <dn>I</dn> have become like a man Who has no strength, [5] Released among the dead, Like slain ones lying in the burial-site, Whom <dn>You</dn> have remembered no more, And who have been cut off from <dn>Your</dn> hand. [6] <dn>You</dn> have put me in the lowest pit, In dark places, in the depths. [7] <dn>Your</dn> wrath has rested heavily upon me, And <dn>You</dn> have afflicted me with all <dn>Your</dn> breakers. Selah. [8] <dn>You</dn> have put away <dn>my</dn> friends far from me; <dn>You</dn> have made me an abomination to them; <dn>I</dn> am shut in and do not go out; [9] <dn>My</dn> eye grows dim because of affliction. <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>I</dn> have called upon <dn>You</dn>, all day long; <dn>I</dn> have stretched out <dn>my</dn> hands to <dn>You</dn>.

readings.title: Forsaken in Darkness
readings.subtitle: The psalmist questions if God's wonders are known in the grave, feeling rejected and overwhelmed by divine wrath.
readings.text: [Psalm 88:10] Would <dn>You</dn> work wonders for the dead? Would the dead rise to praise <dn>You</dn>? Selah. [11] Is <dn>Your</dn> loving-commitment declared in the burial-site? <dn>Your</dn> trustworthiness in the place of destruction? [12] Are <dn>Your</dn> wonders known in the dark? And <dn>Your</dn> righteousness in the land of no remembrance? [13] But <dn>I</dn>, unto <dn>You</dn> <dn>I</dn> have cried, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, And in the morning <dn>my</dn> prayer comes before <dn>You</dn>. [14] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, why do <dn>You</dn> reject me? Why do <dn>You</dn> hide <dn>Your</dn> face from me? [15] <dn>I</dn> am afflicted and dying from childhood; <dn>I</dn> have borne frightening matters from <dn>You</dn>; <dn>I</dn> am in despair. [16] <dn>Your</dn> fierce wrath has gone over me; <dn>Your</dn> onslaughts have cut me off. [17] They surrounded me like water all day long; They close in upon me altogether. [18] <dn>You</dn> have put loved one and companion far from me, Darkness is <dn>my</dn> close friend!

readings.title: The Covenant with David
readings.subtitle: Ethan the Ezrahite declares he will sing of YeHoVaH's loving-commitment and recalls the sworn promise to David.
readings.text: [Psalm 89:1] <dn>I</dn> sing of the loving-commitment of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> forever; With <dn>my</dn> mouth <dn>I</dn> make known <dn>Your</dn> trustworthiness To all generations. [2] For <dn>I</dn> said, <dq>Loving-commitment is built up forever; <dn>You</dn> establish <dn>Your</dn> trustworthiness in the heavens.</dq> [3] <dn>You</dn> said, <dq><dn>I</dn> have made a covenant with <dn>My</dn> chosen, <dn>I</dn> have sworn to <dn>My</dn> servant Daviḏ:</dq> [4] <dq><dn>I</dn> establish your seed forever, And shall build up your throne to all generations.’ </dq> Selah.

readings.title: Praise for YeHoVaH's Power and Sovereignty
readings.subtitle: The heavens praise His wonders, for none can compare to Him who rules the sea and founded the earth.
readings.text: [Psalm 89:5] And the heavens praise <dn>Your</dn> wonders, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>Your</dn> trustworthiness, too, In the assembly of the set-apart ones. [6] For who in the heavens is comparable to <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>? Who among the sons of the mighty is like <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>? [7] <dn>Ěl</dn> is greatly feared In the company of the set-apart ones, And awesome above all those around <dn>Him</dn>. [8] O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn> of hosts, Who is mighty like <dn>You</dn>, O Yah? And <dn>Your</dn> trustworthiness is all around <dn>You</dn>. [9] <dn>You</dn> rule the swelling of the sea; When its waves rise, <dn>You</dn> still them. [10] <dn>You</dn> have broken <dn>את</dn> Rahaḇ in pieces, as one who is slain; <dn>You</dn> have scattered <dn>Your</dn> enemies With the arm of <dn>Your</dn> strength. [11] The heavens are <dn>Yours</dn>, The earth also is <dn>Yours</dn>; The world and all that fills it. <dn>You</dn> have founded <dn>את</dn> them. [12] North and south – <dn>You</dn> have created them; Taḇor and Ḥermon rejoice in <dn>Your</dn> Name. [13] <dn>You</dn> have a mighty arm, <dn>Your</dn> hand is strong, <dn>Your</dn> right hand exalted. [14] Righteousness and right-ruling Are the foundation of <dn>Your</dn> throne; Loving-commitment and truth go before <dn>Your</dn> face. [15] Blessed are the people Who know the sounding! They walk, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, in the light of <dn>Your</dn> face. [16] In <dn>Your</dn> Name they rejoice all day long, And they are exalted in <dn>Your</dn> righteousness . [17] For <dn>You</dn> are the comeliness of their strength, And by <dn>Your</dn> good pleasure our horn is exalted. [18] For <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is our shield, And the Set-apart One of Yisra’ěl is our Sovereign.

readings.title: The Details of the Davidic Covenant
readings.subtitle: YeHoVaH recounts His promise to establish David's throne forever, ensuring His loving-commitment despite future transgressions.
readings.text: [Psalm 89:19] Then <dn>You</dn> spoke in a vision to <dn>Your</dn> lovingly-committed one, And <dn>You</dn> said, <dq><dn>I</dn> have given help to one who is mighty, <dn>I</dn> have exalted one chosen from the people.</dq> [20] <dq>“<dn>I</dn> have found <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> servant Daviḏ; With <dn>My</dn> set-apart oil <dn>I</dn> anointed him,</dq> [21] <dq>“With whom <dn>My</dn> hand is established; <dn>My</dn> arm also strengthens him.</dq> [22] <dq>“No enemy subjects him to tribute, And no son of wickedness afflicts him.</dq> [23] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall beat down <dn>His</dn> adversaries before his face, And plague <dn>את</dn> those who hate him.</dq> [24] <dq>“But <dn>My</dn> trustworthiness And <dn>My</dn> loving-commitment are with him, And in <dn>My</dn> Name his horn is exalted.</dq> [25] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall set <dn>את</dn> his hand on the sea, And <dn>את</dn> his right hand on the rivers.</dq> [26] <dq>“<dn>He</dn> calls out to <dn>Me</dn>, ‘<dn>You</dn> are <dn>my</dn> Father, <dn>My</dn> <dn>Ěl</dn>, and the rock of <dn>my</dn> deliverance.’</dq> [27] <dq>“<dn>I</dn> also appoint him first-born, Highest of the sovereigns of the earth.</dq> [28] <dq>“<dn>I</dn> guard <dn>My</dn> loving-commitment for him forever, And <dn>My</dn> covenant is steadfast with him.</dq> [29] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall establish <dn>את</dn> his seed forever, And <dn>את</dn> his throne as the days of the heavens.</dq> [30] <dq>“If his sons forsake <dn>My</dn> Torah And do not walk in <dn>My</dn> right-rulings,</dq> [31] <dq>“If they profane <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> laws And do not guard <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> commands,</dq> [32] <dq>“Then <dn>I</dn> shall visit their transgression with the rod, And their crookedness with flogging.</dq> [33] <dq>“But <dn>My</dn> loving-commitment <dn>I</dn> do not take away from him, Nor be false to <dn>My</dn> trustworthiness.</dq> [34] <dq>“<dn>I</dn> shall not profane <dn>My</dn> covenant, Neither would <dn>I</dn> change what has gone out from <dn>My</dn> lips.</dq> [35] <dq>“Once <dn>I</dn> have sworn by <dn>My</dn> set-apartness, <dn>I</dn> do not lie to Daviḏ:</dq> [36] <dq>“<dn>His</dn> seed shall be forever, And his throne as the sun before <dn>Me</dn>;</dq> [37] <dq>“Like the moon, it is established forever, And the witness in the heaven is steadfast.”</dq> Selah.

readings.title: A Lament Over the Broken Covenant
readings.subtitle: The psalmist contrasts the promise with the present reality of rejection, reproach, and shame upon God's anointed.
readings.text: [Psalm 89:38] Yet <dn>You</dn> have rejected and spurned, <dn>You</dn> have been wroth with <dn>Your</dn> anointed. [39] <dn>You</dn> have disowned <dn>את</dn> the covenant of <dn>Your</dn> servant, <dn>You</dn> have defiled his diadem in the dust. [40] <dn>You</dn> have broken down all his hedges, <dn>You</dn> have brought his strongholds to ruin. [41] All who pass by the way plunder him; <dn>He</dn> is a reproach to his neighbours. [42] <dn>You</dn> have exalted the right hand of his adversaries, <dn>You</dn> have made all his enemies rejoice. [43] Moreover <dn>You</dn> have turned back the edge of his sword, And have not made him stand in battle. [44] <dn>You</dn> have brought an end to his splendour, And have hurled his throne to the ground. [45] <dn>You</dn> have shortened the days of his youth, <dn>You</dn> have covered him with shame. Selah. [46] How long, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, would <dn>You</dn> be hidden? Would <dn>Your</dn> wrath burn like fire forever? [47] Please remember how short <dn>my</dn> time is; Why should you have created all the sons of men for naught? [48] What man would live and not see death? Who rescues his life from the power of She’ol? Selah. [49] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, where are <dn>Your</dn> former loving-commitments, Which <dn>You</dn> swore to Daviḏ in <dn>Your</dn> trustworthiness? [50] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, remember <dn>את</dn> the reproach of <dn>Your</dn> servants, That <dn>I</dn> have borne in <dn>my</dn> bosom – Of all the many peoples, [51] With which <dn>Your</dn> enemies have reproached, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, With which they have reproached <dn>את</dn> the footsteps of <dn>Your</dn> anointed. [52] Blessed be <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> forever! Aměn and Aměn.
